{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.00

|gr1= Turrets

|descr= Returns the turret path the given vehicle's gunner is in.
To get the turret's unit see [[turretUnit]].

|s1= vehicle [[unitTurret]] gunner

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= gunner: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Turret Path]]
- {{hl|[-1]}} is returned if the [[gunner]] is also the [[driver]].
When no units are in any of vehicle's turret, empty array {{hl|[]}} is returned.

|x1= <sqf>_vehicle unitTurret _gunner;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>vehicle player unitTurret player;</sqf>
